title.zh: Fish Audio开源Drama 3：基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，主打精细语音控制
title.en: Fish Audio开源Drama 3：基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，主打精细语音控制

current_state.zh: AI speech company Fish Audio open-sourced the Drama 3 voice model — a 35B-parameter, 3B-active Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-based system with 83-language support and natural-language fine-grained control over emotional delivery, laughter, and multi-speaker dialogue — alongside weights, inference code, and a technical report, after topping Artificial Analysis' English pronunciation accuracy test at 93.2%.
